name: TensoRF
definition: A factorized tensorial radiance field that represents continuous volume density ($σ$) and view-dependent color ($c$) using tensor factorization (CP or VM) to achieve compact modeling and fast reconstruction.
summary: TensoRF is a compact 3D radiance field representation that decomposes volume data into low-rank tensor components, offering faster reconstruction and smaller model sizes than neural network-based methods.
